title: Transform UI to vibrant, playful, and energetic design with bold animations

requirements.summary: Replace entire color scheme with vibrant, playful palette in frontend/src/index.css
acceptanceCriteria: CSS variables in frontend/src/index.css define vibrant primary colors (not blues)
Accent colors are bold and energetic
Card backgrounds use colorful gradients or highlights
Interactive elements have vivid hover states

file_operations.description: Replace the current IC Markets-inspired blue/gray color scheme with vibrant, playful colors using OKLCH color space. Define bold primary colors (e.g., vibrant purples, magentas, oranges), energetic accent colors (bright yellows, cyans, pinks), colorful gradients for backgrounds, and vivid hover state colors. Update all CSS custom properties including --primary, --secondary, --accent, --card, --background, and chart colors to reflect the new energetic palette.

Apply vibrant colors to offer cards, use colorful gradients for promotional highlights, and update badge styling with energetic accent colors.
Update report cards with colorful backgrounds, apply bold accent colors to section headers, and use vibrant colors for export buttons.
Apply vibrant colors to calculator interface, use colorful backgrounds for reminder cards, and update result displays with energetic accent colors.
Update stats cards with bold accent colors, apply colorful backgrounds to earnings displays, and use vibrant colors for referral link section.
Apply vibrant colors to settings sections, use colorful borders for form groups, and update action buttons with energetic accent colors.

requirements.summary: Add parallax scrolling effects to LandingPage component
acceptanceCriteria: Hero section implements parallax effect on scroll
Background elements move at different rates than foreground
Parallax creates noticeable depth perception
Scroll performance remains smooth

file_operations.description: Implement parallax scrolling effects using Framer Motion's useScroll and useTransform hooks or a parallax library. Apply parallax to hero section background elements, feature showcase backgrounds, and decorative elements. Configure different scroll speeds for foreground content vs background layers to create depth. Ensure smooth performance by optimizing transform calculations and using will-change CSS property where appropriate.

requirements.summary: Implement animated gradient backgrounds throughout the application
acceptanceCriteria: Key sections display continuously animating gradients
Gradient animations are smooth and performant
Animation speed is appropriate (not too fast/slow)
Animated backgrounds use vibrant colors from the new palette

file_operations.description: Define CSS keyframe animations for gradient backgrounds that continuously shift between vibrant colors from the new palette. Create animation classes like 'animate-gradient' with appropriate duration (e.g., 6-10 seconds) and background-size/position transforms for smooth color transitions. Ensure animations are GPU-accelerated for performance.
Apply animated gradient backgrounds to hero section, feature showcase areas, and key content sections using the CSS animation classes defined in index.css.
Add animated gradient backgrounds to dashboard header and featured metric cards using CSS animation classes.
Apply subtle animated gradient backgrounds to empty state sections or featured account cards.
Add animated gradient backgrounds to header sections or highlighted metric displays.

requirements.summary: Add dynamic hover effects and micro-interactions to all interactive elements
acceptanceCriteria: All buttons scale and change color on hover
Cards lift and glow on hover
Input fields show colorful focus states
Navigation items animate on hover
Hover effects feel energetic and responsive

file_operations.description: Define utility classes for dynamic hover effects including scale transforms (hover:scale-105, hover:scale-110), color transitions, glow effects using box-shadow with vibrant colors, and bounce animations. Add focus state classes for input fields with colorful borders and glows. Create transition classes for smooth, energetic animations (duration-200, duration-300).
Add hover animations to navigation items including scale, glow, and color shift effects using the utility classes from index.css or Framer Motion whileHover props.
Apply dynamic hover effects to all CTA buttons, feature cards (lift and glow), and interactive links throughout the landing page.
Add hover effects to metric cards (lift and glow), action buttons (scale and color shift), and interactive elements.
Apply hover effects to calculator tabs, calculate buttons, and result sections with scale and glow animations.
Add hover effects to form buttons, input fields (colorful focus states), and dialog action buttons.
Enhance login button with scale transform, glow effect, and color transition on hover using vibrant accent colors.

requirements.summary: Implement smooth page transitions with scale and fade effects in App.tsx
acceptanceCriteria: Route changes trigger page transition animations
Exiting pages fade/scale out smoothly
Entering pages fade/scale in dynamically
Transitions complete within 300-500ms

file_operations.description: Wrap route rendering with Framer Motion's AnimatePresence component to enable exit animations. Apply page-level animations using motion.div with initial, animate, and exit props featuring scale (0.95-1.0) and opacity (0-1) transitions. Set transition duration to 300-400ms for dynamic, energetic feel. Ensure each route has a unique key for proper animation triggering.

file_operations.description: Create a reusable LoadingSpinner component using vibrant colors from the new palette. Implement spinning animation using CSS animations or Framer Motion with colorful gradient effects. Export multiple size variants (small, medium, large) for different use cases.

Create a reusable SkeletonCard component with animated shimmer effect using vibrant colors. Implement CSS animation with gradient background that shifts across the skeleton. Export variants for different card types (metric card, account card, payout card, etc.).
Add loading states using LoadingSpinner and SkeletonCard components for metric cards and data sections while fetching data.
Implement loading states with skeleton cards for account listings during data fetch.
Add animated loading indicators for payout history data fetching using skeleton components.
Implement loading states for trading metrics and chart data using colorful loading spinner and skeleton screens.
Add loading state with colorful spinner during authentication verification and initial data loading.
